description:
A texture artist needs to prepare a monkey head (Suzanne) mesh for texturing. The mesh currently has NO UV map — all UV layers have been removed. You must:

1. Select the Suzanne mesh object in the scene
2. UV unwrap it (enter Edit Mode, select all faces, and use UV Mapping > Smart UV Project or any appropriate unwrap method)
3. Create or modify Suzanne's material to include a Checker Texture node:
   - Add a Checker Texture node in the Shader Editor
   - Set the Checker Texture Scale to a value between 5 and 30 (e.g., 10)
   - Connect the Checker Texture 'Color' output to the Principled BSDF 'Base Color' input
4. Render the scene (Render > Render Image or press F12) and save the rendered image to: /home/ga/BlenderProjects/checker_render.png
5. Save the Blender project to: /home/ga/BlenderProjects/suzanne_checker.blend

The scene already contains Suzanne (subdivided, smooth-shaded), a ground plane, camera, and sun light. The render engine is set to EEVEE for fast rendering.

A successful result shows the monkey head covered in a clearly visible black-and-white checker pattern that follows the surface curvature, confirming proper UV mapping.
